body:
This modpack is a modpack for Create lovers. It has over 140 mods.

This modpack includes:

-Create Mods/Add-ons ([Create Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons), [Create Crafts & Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/createaddition), [Create Deco](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-deco)...)

-Furniture Mods ([Another Furniture](https://modrinth.com/mod/another-furniture), [Macaw's Furniture](https://modrinth.com/mod/macaws-furniture)...)

-[Terralith](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith)

-[Vic's Point Blank](https://modrinth.com/mod/vics-point-blank)

-APIs

-other stuff

 

## 

### <Create>

Create is a Minecraft mod that lets you build complex machines, factories, and conveyor systems using gears, rotation, and mechanical power. It’s a visually impressive alternative to traditional Redstone with a strong industrial vibe.

##

### <Point Blank>

Point Blank is a Minecraft mod that adds customizable firearms and ranged weapons to the game. It focuses on tight, fast-paced combat with detailed gun mechanics, attachments, and crafting. Perfect for players who want more action and a modern twist to their survival experience.

##

### <Terralith>

Terralith is a Minecraft world generation mod that completely overhauls the Overworld with stunning, realistic and fantasy-inspired terrain—without adding any new blocks. It features over 100 unique biomes, from towering mountain ranges and volcanic landscapes to lush valleys and dramatic canyons, all designed to make exploration feel fresh and immersive. With massive cliffs, deep oceans and breathtaking land formations, Terralith delivers epic, visually impressive worlds while staying fully compatible with vanilla Minecraft.

##

### <Another Furniture>

Another Furniture is a Minecraft mod that adds stylish, functional furniture to the game—like chairs, tables, shelves, and more. It's fully survival-friendly and adapts to different wood types, making your builds feel way more cozy and detailed without breaking immersion.

##

### <Animalistic>

Animalistic is a Minecraft mod that adds unique, fantasy-inspired animals to the game—some friendly, some dangerous. Each creature has custom behaviors and abilities, making exploration feel more alive and unpredictable. It’s fully survival-compatible and blends naturally into the world, adding a wild twist without breaking immersion.
